[P2] Reconcile the failed-start decision in the design

Rule 7, “List the decisions that the task did not cover,” requires the implemented edge-case decisions and their reasons in the description. The description explicitly says a failed thread start consumes a job number, while this assignment and the new regression test implement the opposite. Maintainers are therefore reviewing a different counting contract from the one being added. Following rules 8 and 9, return to the design phase, settle when a job counts, and record the chosen behavior and reason for maintainer agreement.
